Strictly stock playback: software decode through the standard G-NEXT path with no extra tweaks.

Skips the deblocking filter on non reference frames (big CPU saving, minor quality cost), uses a 1 second audio buffer, and upscales with Lanczos sharp. Not always recommended. Some Hi10P streams get major AV sync or framedrop issues with this. If that happens, switch back to no tuning and/or restart your Shield.

Light tuning plus frame dropping: when the Shield\'s audio clock slips and video starts drifting out of sync, the player drops late frames to stay in sync instead of drifting until you reboot. Use this if audio and video desync over time. Not always recommended. Some Hi10P streams get major AV sync or framedrop issues with this. If that happens, switch back to no tuning and/or restart your Shield.
Automatically pause playback while the controls overlay is visible, so navigating doesn\'t fight the decoder for CPU. Applies to every file.

On Shield devices, automatically pause playback while the controls overlay is visible during Hi10P H.264 files (where the SW decoder is too tight to share CPU with the UI). Independent of the general option above — turn off if you\'d rather accept some A/V drift to keep video running.
